title: Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Cannot assign to read only property 'aroundRadius' of object '#<Object>'
explanation: This GitHub issue reports a critical bug in the `react-instantsearch-core` library, causing a TypeError when using the `Configure` component with `aroundRadius` set to 'all'. The negative sentiment and frustration emotion are justified due to the severity of the issue and its impact on the application.
